facts.text: I am seeing an error when running a script that outputs StartTime: 11:55:46:87 and Generate try: 1.
The script attempts to download metadata from http://localhost:6800/service using WS-Metadata Exchange or DISCO.
The error message says it cannot obtain metadata from http://localhost:6800/service.
The output includes Microsoft Service Model Metadata Tool and Microsoft Windows Communication Foundation version 4.8.3928.0.
The error message says metadata contains a reference that cannot be resolved: http://localhost:6800/service.
The error message says there was no endpoint listening on http://localhost:6800/service that could accept the SOAP message.
The error message indicates the server returned HTTP 404 Not Found for http://localhost:6800/service.
The output includes an HTTP GET error for http://localhost:6800/service and says the operation timed out.
The script suggests using svcutil /? for more help.

events.text: The script fails to download WCF service metadata from http://localhost:6800/service and returns code 3.
